nodes.name: NiFe-LDH Hydrothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Carbon fiber paper (CFP) was preprocessed with HNO3 to guarantee a hydrophilic surface. Ni(NO3)2·6H2O (1.28 mM), Fe(NO3)3·H2O (0.33 mM), urea (2.86 mM), sodium citrate (0.14 mM) were stirred and mixed completely to obtain clear aqueous solution of 60 mL. Then CFP was immersed into aforementioned aqueous in a 80 mL stainless-steel autoclave, reacting at 120 °C for 18 h, later cooling down to 25 °C naturally. The orange yellow film formed on CFP substrate was cleaned with deionized water and ethanol three times, then dried at 50 °C overnight.

nodes.name: (Ni,Fe)S2@MoS2 Heterostructure Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Thioacetamide (PAA) (6.25 mM), Na2MoO4·2H2O (1.25 mM) mixed fully to form a transparent aqueous solution of 50 mL and transferred to Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave. Then the as-prepared NiFe-LDH/CFP film was immersed into aforementioned aqueous, heating at 200 °C for 8 h (Mo:S = 1:5), afterwards cooling down to 25 °C naturally. The black film with metallic luster prepared on CFP was cleaned with distilled water and ethanol three times, then dried at 50 °C overnight.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD pattern shows superimposition of (Ni,Fe)S₂ (Ni rich) phase (JCPDS #02-0850) and 2H-MoS₂ phase (JCPDS #37-1492).
nodes.evidence_snippet: the (Ni, Fe)S₂@MoS₂ heterostructures were prepared which show a superimposition of (Ni, Fe)S₂ phase and MoS₂ phase... (200), (210), (211), (220) and (311) reflection of (Ni, Fe)S₂ (Ni rich) phase (JCPDS # 02-0850) as well as (002) and (006) reflection of 2H⋅MoS₂ phase (JCPDS# 37-1492) are clearly observed.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows (Ni,Fe)S₂ nanoboxes decorated with MoS₂ nanosheets forming thick sheet-like arrays on CFP with lateral size of 200 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images of NiFe-LDH NSAs exhibit a ultrathin and uniform network... with an intercrossing decorated MoS₂ nanosheets vertically grafting onto the (Ni, Fe)S₂ nanoboxes.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM confirms MoS₂ nanosheets decorated uprightly on (Ni,Fe)S₂ nanoboxes planes with discontinuous stripes indicating Fe doping into NiS₂ lattice.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The transmission electron microscopic (TEM) image of (Ni, Fe)S₂@MoS₂... further confirms that the hydrothermal synthesis of MoS₂ nanosheets are decorated uprightly on the plane of (Ni, Fe)S₂ nanoboxes.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows lattice fringes of 0.27 nm for (Ni,Fe)S₂ (200) plane and 0.62 nm for MoS₂ (002) plane.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Additionally, high resolution TEM (HRTEM) shows lattice fringes with 0.27 nm in the inner layer of nanoboxes and 0.62 nm in the decorated layer, corresponding to the (Ni, Fe)S₂ (200) and MoS₂ (002) planes, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS mapping reveals uniform dispersion of Mo, S, Ni, and Fe on carbon fiber paper.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Element mapping analysis of (Ni, Fe)S₂@MoS₂ reveals a uniform dispersion of Mo, S, Ni, and Fe on carbon fiber paper, indicating the homogeneous distribution of MoS₂ nanoarrays on (Ni, Fe)S₂ nanoboxes.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS confirms electron transfer from (Ni,Fe)S₂ to MoS₂: Mo 3d peaks shift lower (232.31, 228.81, 226.21 eV), S 2p shows S²⁻/S₂²⁻ with negative shifts, Ni 2p (Ni²⁺/Ni³⁺) and Fe 2p show positive shifts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: After the formation of (Ni, Fe)S₂@MoS₂ core-shell nanostructure, all three peaks slightly shift to lower energy (232.31, 228.81 and 226.21 eV, respectively), representing the electron transfer from (Ni, Fe)S₂ to MoS₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: (Ni,Fe)S₂@MoS₂ has C_dl = 0.67 mF cm⁻² (1.8× (Ni,Fe)S₂'s 0.37 mF cm⁻², 2.7× MoS₂'s 0.25 mF cm⁻²), measured at 20-120 mV s⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: (Ni, Fe)S₂@MoS₂ heterostructures show the largest ECSA (0.67 mF cm⁻²), which gives 1.8 and 2.7 times higher C_dl than that of (Ni, Fe)S₂ (0.37 mF cm⁻²) and MoS₂ (0.25 mF cm⁻²).

nodes.characterization_summary: (Ni,Fe)S₂@MoS₂ shows smallest charge-transfer resistance R_ct and lowest ion diffusion resistance.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The (Ni, Fe)S₂@MoS₂ heterostructures show the smallest R_ct, which indicates their faster electron transport kinetic and intrinsic excellent electron conductivity.

nodes.characterization_summary: In-situ Raman shows S-H_ads peak at 2574 cm⁻¹ for (Ni,Fe)S₂@MoS₂ (vs 2577 cm⁻¹ for (Ni,Fe)S₂ and 2646 cm⁻¹ for MoS₂), indicating weaker S-H_ads bonds.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the negative shift of S-H_ads of (Ni, Fe)S₂@MoS₂ (2574 cm⁻¹) compared with that of (Ni, Fe)S₂ (2577 cm⁻¹) and MoS₂ (2646 cm⁻¹), implying that the S-H_ads bonds on (Ni, Fe)S₂@MoS₂ are weaker than those on (Ni, Fe)S₂ and MoS₂.
